description: Header file declaring functions related to the 'merge-ort' merging strategy in a version control system. It includes function prototypes for non-recursive, recursive, and generic merge operations with rename detection.

methods.name: merge_ort_nonrecursive
methods.description: Performs a non-recursive, rename-detecting three-way merge, mimicking an older merge function.

methods.name: merge_ort_recursive
methods.description: Performs a recursive, rename-detecting three-way merge with ancestor consolidation.

methods.name: merge_ort_generic
methods.description: Performs a generic, rename-detecting three-way merge with multiple merge bases.
